Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Marketing Internship at Schneider Electric. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content creation, and campaign support, I am eager to contribute to your Marketing and Communication team and grow my skills in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has honed my ability to juggle multiple tasks and meet deadlines. My personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates my proactive approach to learning and applying new strategies, including structured data and AI search optimization. I am detail-oriented, collaborative, and passionate about turning data into actionable insights.

I am particularly drawn to Schneider Electric's commitment to sustainability and innovation. The opportunity to work on real campaigns, receive mentorship, and gain insight into the full marketing process aligns perfectly with my career goals. I am confident that my technical marketing foundation and eagerness to learn will make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your impactful work.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Internship at Schneider Electric. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation and a genuine passion for marketing, I am eager to contribute to your team and develop my skills in a real-world, impact-driven environment.

Currently, I work as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, where I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing. I write keyword-targeted blog content that grows organic traffic, and I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. This role has taught me to manage multiple projects simultaneously, meet tight deadlines, and collaborate effectively with clients and team members. I regularly use tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console to track performance and guide decisions—skills directly relevant to the market and customer analysis described in your posting.

My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my proactive approach to learning and applying new marketing strategies. I designed and built the site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD) and entity optimization, and ran iterative SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project demonstrates my attention to detail, problem-solving mindset, and ability to turn data into actionable insights—qualities that align with your need for a proactive and detail-oriented intern.

I am particularly drawn to Schneider Electric's commitment to sustainability and innovation. The opportunity to support campaigns that generate demand and build brand awareness, while learning from experienced professionals, is exactly the hands-on experience I am seeking. I am a quick learner, comfortable with new tools, and eager to contribute to a welcoming, inclusive team.

Thank you for considering my application. I am excited about the possibility of bringing my skills and enthusiasm to Schneider Electric and growing as a marketing professional.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
